description: CVSS v3 score calculator — Score any CVSS v3.0 or v3.1 vector offline: base score and severity (NONE..CRITICAL), optional temporal score (E/RL/RC), impact and exploitability subscores, each metric spelled out, a patch priority (PATCH NOW, PATCH THIS CYCLE, SCHEDULE, LOW PRIORITY) and plain-English risk notes. Pairs with /v1/security/cve and /v1/security/kev. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
